content:
incident-bot: PAGER -> kv-cache-mismatch spikes on hosted-generation (error rate 4.6% over 3m). Severity: P1. Paging #incidents and @alice. Link: /runbooks/kv-cache-issues

alice (oncall): Acked. Looking now. Paging @ben for triage. Initial customer impact: some completions look stale/repeated for long-context prompts (small %). :rotating_light:

ben (sre): I'm on it. I see invalidation errors from the new kernel/kern-slab patch; KV entries not being evicted properly. Quick mitigation: disable prefix/KV caching for hosted-gen-eu and route traffic to fallback model variant. Command I'm about to run: `/runbook disable-kv-cache hosted-gen-eu`

ben (sre): Config change I'll apply (example):
```
service: serving-runtime
pool: hosted-gen-eu
kv_cache: enabled -> false
rollout_id: r-20260317-01
```

alice (oncall): Executing mitigation now (/runbook disable-kv-cache hosted-gen-eu). ETA ~30s. Drafting status page copy below — please review quickly.

alice (oncall): STATUS UPDATE (investigating):
- We are investigating an issue affecting generated completions in the EU hosted pool. Some requests may return stale or repeated text.
- Impact: a small subset of generation requests (approx 3-5%) may be affected; embedded and non-generation endpoints unaffected.
- Mitigation: we are routing traffic around cache layer and applying a temporary configuration change. No customer data loss.
- Next update: 30 minutes or sooner.

sara (product): LGTM. Add a clear sentence: "No customer data loss; responses may be degraded (latency) while mitigation is active." Also include support contact: support@redwood.ai

marco (support): Noted. I'll prepare a short customer-facing template for affected customers (esp. Dedicated):
"We are currently investigating an issue that may cause occasional stale outputs for a small % of requests. Engineers have applied a mitigation and are monitoring. We will follow up in 30 minutes with an update. Contact support@redwood.ai for questions."

ben (sre): Mitigation applied: KV cache disabled on hosted-gen-eu (rollout r-20260317-01). Error rate dropped from 4.6% -> 0.4% in the last 2m. Monitoring dashboards: CPU up ~3%, latency +60-120ms. Keeping cache off until root cause fixed. Initial RCA points to race during eviction path introduced in kernel patch.

alice (oncall): Posting update to status page now. Internal action items: 1) RCA & patch, 2) add guard in eviction code, 3) canary re-enable cache + gradual rollout. Handing monitoring to @ben — I'll be offline ~2h.

ben (sre): Acknowledged. I'll post periodic updates. Draft follow-up update (T+30m):
"Update: mitigation successfully reduced error rate; traffic routed around cache layer. No evidence of data loss. Engineers continue to investigate root cause and will provide next update within 30 minutes."

statusbot: Status page published: incident id INC-2026-0317-42. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0317-42

marco (support): Customer email queued for tiered customers. Support play: if customers report anomalies, advise session reroute and include incident id.

ben (sre): RESOLVED (draft): root cause patched (race in kv invalidation). Canary re-enable looks good on 3/5 nodes; error rate stable ~0.05%. Re-enabled cache fully at 3555551600, rollout id r-20260317-02. Draft resolved copy: "Resolved: we have fixed the issue causing stale outputs, re-enabled caching, and verified traffic has returned to normal. If you continue to see anomalous outputs, contact support@redwood.ai and include incident INC-2026-0317-42."

alice (oncall): Confirming resolved. Closing pager. Excellent work everyone :tada:

statusbot: Status page updated -> Resolved. Incident INC-2026-0317-42 closed.
